q1_issues.issue: The bare plural 'quartet members' is given a definite group witness, but the determiner rule (not meaning) decides a plural subject and a bare plural is the generic, taking Inheritance on the kind.

'quartet members' is fused into the compound quartet_member although 'quartet' is the whole and 'member' its member, which the possessor/whole test excludes from fusion, so the Quartet itself gets no symbol and no PartOf link.

q2_gaps: a stated split/tally on a predicate ('divided 3-1') — the ratio has no licensed encoding, and only the 'rest' side survives here as a Cardinality
a collective/aggregate predicate over a BARE plural — the determiner rule sends bare plurals to Inheritance on the kind, which cannot carry a collection-level property like 'divided 3-1'
discourse-initial 'But' with no second clause in the sentence — an adversative pointing at prior discourse has no in-sentence endpoint to relate

a graded status inside a seal — deontic 'should' requires strength 0.7, but a sealed term carries one STV and has no per-atom strength carrier, so (Obligated sk_treat_1) records the modal without its force
notes: Against, On, As and Of are all preposition-named heads, and the RestOf/SubsetOf remainder shape plus the reified-state-with-PP-complement dual-emit are handled correctly. (Cardinality sk_rest_1 3) is read off '3-1' by arithmetic, a small inferential step but traceable to the words.
